role: Structural integrity validation and attractor early-warning detection for the knowledge graph.
detail: Implements two distinct systems: validate_graph_integrity() runs three structural checks (provenance validity, temporal invariants, classification consistency) against CANON A.8/A.11; check_attractor_warnings() detects four pathological attractor states (ossification, guardian_dependency, hallucinated_structure, plus a 4th mentioned in CANON A.8 but not implemented here). IntegrityFinding reports definite constraint violations with severity (error/warning), check_name, node_id, and message. AttractorWarning reports system-health patterns with warning_type, severity, message, and detailed numerical triggers. Both functions use duck-typed edge access via query_edges() on persistence objects, gracefully falling back when unavailable.
gotchas: Hallucinated structure check fires any Schema node with <2 instances (including 0), suggesting spurious patterns; ossification only simplified Phase 1 check (type_count==0 after 20 sessions); guardian_dependency uses infinite ratio when applied_count==0 (any pending proposals fire); fourth CANON A.8 attractor mentioned in docstring but not implemented; all edge-dependent checks degrade silently if query_edges() missing.
